data.message: If you are taking requests... Please add Stick Pickup (and everything else a sled can carry), and expand the pickup radius. It is annoying you have to mow directly over the object to pick it up.
I am running into a little issue. When I try to mow logs into the sled, the logs don't go into the sled; they get mashed under the ground.
Are you planning to add auto stick pickup?
